description: Mantra Lv5 single-cast FULL HIT theoretical data. Values are community wiki estimates; candidate list NOT exhaustive. All segments summed assuming same target hit. No target resist, no proc damage.

mantras.name: Ceaseless Slashes
mantras.warning: CONFLICTING SOURCE: Deepwoken Builder reports 290 Lv5 base after 2025 nerfs; 310.05 Fandom tick breakdown is unverified on current patch. Additional slashes possible with ether/timing.
mantras.caveat: Wiki detailed 20-hit sum 310.05 conflicts with builder Lv5 base 290; do not call this verified maximum.
